content: npm 'uuid' package v14.0.1 (RFC9562-compliant), 15.3k GH stars, 265M weekly downloads, zero runtime deps, 66KB unpacked, browser-safe via Web Crypto (crypto.getRandomValues), supports v1/v3/v4/v5/v6/v7 with one consistent API including validate()/version()/parse()/stringify(). Confirmed current major version supports v7 natively.
